symptom: `alter entity Mod.Ent rename attribute Old to New` rewrote the XPath constraint of every document whose constraint has a line break between predicate groups (`[Status = 'Open']\n[Code = 'X']` -> `[Status = 'Open'][Code = 'X']`), in every module, whether or not it named the attribute, and reported each as "Updated N XPath constraint(s) in N document(s)". One rename wrote 147 units in 21 modules on a real project; a constraint that did name the attribute lost its line breaks too. Model meaning unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
cause: rewriteConstraint split the stored constraint with visitor.SplitXPathPredicateGroups (which returns the groups and drops the whitespace between and around them) and returned strings.Join(groups, "") even when no group changed. The scanner decides 'unit changed' and counts a rewrite by comparing that result with the stored string, so the lost separators alone made a write and a count. canon.Reconcile could not elide it: the content really did differ.
insight: A split helper that discards information is fine for describe and validation, never for write-back: write-back over a split must splice each changed piece at its offset and return the INPUT ITSELF when nothing changed — 'no edit' has to mean 'same string', not 'a rebuild that usually compares equal'. The package doc already promised 'leaves every other byte alone'; it held within a group and not between groups, and the existing no-write test (TestScanDoesNotWriteUnchangedUnits) used single-group constraints, which have no between-group whitespace to lose — so it passed against the bug. Test multi-group constraints with \n / CRLF / tab separators and leading/trailing whitespace, and give a 'nothing written' test a control unit that IS written (else a store that records nothing passes). Repro needs a BSON edit: mxcli's own authoring still flattens between-group line breaks (retrieve `where [a]\n[b]` is stored `[a][b]`; #1542 kept only within-group layout). Measured on 10.24.24 and 11.13.0 with stored line breaks: baseline 4 constraints / 4 units written (two untouched-meaning microflows among them), fixed 2 / 2 (the referencing retrieve and the access rule), line breaks kept, UnusedX untouched, mx check 0 errors.
